subject: Customer evidence: regional deployment attestation & private peering clarifications
messages:
From: Jeremy Langston <compliance@gocomp.io>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@gocomp.io>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: residency attestation + VPC/private peering details

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our vendor risk review (SIG/CAIQ baseline), the security and procurement teams need a concise packet confirming Redwood's hosting and private connectivity controls for GoComp workloads. Specifically we need: 

- A short attestation stating where customer data may be stored/processed (US / EU / APAC) for our account scope.
- A network diagram or VPC peering options that shows private connectivity options (VPC peering, private link, dedicated interconnect) and which options are available for the US region.
- Clarification of key management options (customer-managed KMS, HSM availability) and whether keys are ever exported outside the region.
- If possible, a CSV manifest that lists the region(s) associated with Redwood-hosted models and any on-prem/private deployment timelines.

We're on a tight timeline for our security review — can you provide the above by EOD Wednesday (6/2)? If you'd prefer we can accept a preliminary packet and then a follow-up for deeper artifacts.

Attachments: sample SIG questionnaire (we used for other vendors)

Thanks,
Jeremy Langston
Vendor Risk Manager
GoComp Health
[Attachment: GoComp_SIG_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jeremy Langston <compliance@gocomp.io>
Cc: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@gocomp.io>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: residency attestation + VPC/private peering details

Hi Jeremy & Alice,

Appreciate the clear list — we'll get you a focused packet. High-level answers here and I'll send files shortly: 

1) Residency attestation: Redwood processes customer inference requests in the region selected at deployment. For GoComp's planned US account, data touching inference runtime (input tokens, KV cache, outputs) will remain in the US region endpoints we assign; backups and control-plane metadata are retained per our retention policy and are region-aware. I'll provide a one-paragraph attestation signed by our Compliance lead.

2) Private connectivity: We support three patterns for private deployments in US regions:
   - VPC peering (customer VPC <-> Redwood dedicated VPC endpoint)
   - PrivateLink / Private Endpoints (managed private endpoint with restricted egress)
   - Dedicated interconnect via partner carriers (for customers requiring MPLS/dedicated pipes)

   I'll attach a simple diagram showing how traffic flows for each option and which features (TLS, mutual TLS, private routing) are included.

3) KMS/HSM & key residency: We offer customer-managed keys via KMS integrations in supported cloud regions. Keys are never exported outside the configured region. For customers requiring HSM-backed key storage we offer HSM-managed KMS as an add-on for Dedicated and Private deployments.

4) Manifest & timeline: Attached is a CSV manifest that maps our common model variants to primary hosting regions and an estimated on-prem packaging window for Private deployments. For GoComp-specific on-prem timelines we can create a target-runbook during the pilot phase.

I'm attaching: redwood_vpc_arch_diagram.pdf (diagram), region_residency_manifest.csv (manifest). We'll follow with the formal attestation PDF and our SOC2 snapshot.

Let me know if you'd like an annotated walkthrough; happy to set a 30m session with Karthik (networking) and Marissa (deployments).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of GTM Security & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vpc_arch_diagram.pdf (diagram, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: region_residency_manifest.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: residency attestation + VPC/private peering details

Team — forwarding GoComp's request. They want an attestation + VPC diagram + KMS clarifications by EOD Wed. Karthik: can you confirm the peering playbook (IP ranges, accepted routes, required SGs, CNI notes) and whether we need a dedicated interconnect liaison for the pilot? Marissa: can you confirm lead times for Private package (on-prem bundle) and a short note on where logs/audit trails are stored (CloudTrail/Stackdriver equivalent) and retention?

I'll assemble the attestation PDF once you confirm the language. Also include a short bullet list we can publish to the ticket for legal/procurement.

Thanks — Grace

Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: residency attestation + VPC/private peering details

Hi Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups before we close our assessment: 

- Can you attach a SOC2 report (redacted ok) or point us to a secure link? We also need any SIG/CAIQ mappings you maintain for inference/runtime controls.
- For KMS: we need to confirm whether BYOK (bring-your-own-key) is supported for tokens at-rest and whether the KMS key lifecycle events are logged and available for export to our SIEM.
- Please confirm whether any customer data or runtime cache could temporarily be queued in another region during autoscaling/burst scenarios — our policy requires explicit denial or mitigation steps.

If you can drop the SOC2 snapshot and a one-paragraph signed attestation file into the DocuSign/secure evidence link below, procurement will review and circulate to legal. We've also included a redlined MSA; would you have someone review DocuSign by EOD?

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/link/MSA-Redwood-GoComp-2026

Appreciate it — Alice
Vendor Security Lead, GoComp Health
